definitions.full: H7915. sakkin שַׂכִּין noun [masculine] knife (Late Hebrew סַכִּין ; probably loanword (Lewy Fremdw. 176 ) from Aramaic סַכִּינְא , id. , whence also Arabic Nö M 125 Frä 84 ; √ dubious); — absolute ׳שׂ Prov 23:2 .
